output.summary: An annual plant native to the Mediterranean and Asia, rocket has deeply lobed leaves and creamy-white flowers marked with purple veins. Its sharp-tasting leaves are widely eaten in salads, while its flowers, young seed pods and mature seeds are also edible.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves, flowers, young pods and mature seeds are edible; leaves are eaten raw or cooked, and aged seed oil is used for salads and cooking.
